spine.deviation_notes: The two-button DoT-plague maps via drain ailment + on-defender-death trigger (native) + GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade, but the SIGNATURE is an UNBOUNDED cascading room-clear — each death spreads the ED DoT, those spread-DoTs kill, which spread again, rippling across the whole pack. Engine MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 is LOCKED, so the map expresses a single on-death->spread hop — the chain-reaction is truncated to one propagation, never minted deeper per charter law. A player of the original would notice the screen-wide spreading plague becomes a bounded single-hop spread; the 'cast twice and watch the room dissolve in ripples' identity is intact but its unlimited-cascade magnitude is capped.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: TWO-BUTTON DoT-PLAGUE: Essence Drain ticks a chaos DoT; Contagion makes that DoT JUMP to neighbors on death, clearing rooms by spreading (mech_note; dossier skill_loop). Element chaos->shadow (§1); the DoT is literally 'Essence Drain' = the DRAIN ailment (§2 life-drain/essence-drain/decay -> drain; probe guessed 'poison,wither' but this is a hex-DoT namesake-drain, not stacking-venom). ED geometry multi_projectile (the fired bolt); Contagion geometry ground_targeted_circle (the placed debuff zone; probe footprint 'chain-hop' describes the SPREAD, not the cast). The ON-DEATH SPREAD has a NATIVE trigger: proc_trigger_condition=on-defender-death (engine enum, distinct from on-kill, resource_economy.py:134) -> consequence burst-damage/spread (trigger_chain_shape apply-consume-pair: Contagion applies the mark:consumption, death consumes+spreads). CHAIN-DEPTH TRUNCATION: the source is a CASCADING room-clear — death spreads DoT -> that spread DoT kills -> which spreads again -> unbounded across the room. Engine MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 LOCKED: the map expresses ONE on-defender-death->spread step; the unbounded cascade is truncated to single-hop, NOT minted deeper (charter law). T4 GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade (on-death propagation, §5) + PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_saturation (the DoT-saturation reading). CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (on-death DoT-propagation) + probe (mana-spend, chain-hop footprint) per fallback.
